note: outside the 12 cells: two 大島 public buildings of the far zone, round 3 (崎浜保育所 at 3940,7050 and 大島総合開発センター at 3892,6531). Both were derived as tall blocks (3 storeys: the far lots have no measured height) and both are low buildings on Commons photos of 2024-12-01. The far builder draws one oriented box with one roof per lot, so what the photos show beyond a box, a roof shape and colours (the nursery's three connected gables, the centre's balcony railing, roof-deck mesh rail and west hip-roof wing) is NOT drawn and is not claimed here. The Earth 2026-03-11 top view was not re-measured for this round (it gives plan shapes, never heights).
